source_semantics.article_model_statement: % scaled IFBFat in March was included as nutritional condition in the spring-migration-start GLMM; nutritional condition weakly influenced departure timing

temporal_order_gate.rule: retain joined rows only if raw DOY_Start is strictly after March 31 for that year
temporal_order_gate.rationale: any measurement made in March necessarily precedes a spring-migration start after March 31; exact capture date is not required for this subset

primary.estimand: OLS slope of standardized_DOY_Start on scaledIFBFat in temporally safe rows
primary.direction: report two-sided; do not impose sign after seeing source result
primary.uncertainty: animal-cluster bootstrap 10000 replicates using animal ID parsed from id_yr
primary.covariates: none in primary because standardized_DOY_Start is already centered relative to annual median; report year fixed-effect OLS as sensitivity

sensitivities: all source SFig1 rows, labeled source-figure reproduction without guaranteed temporal order
safe rows with year fixed effects
Spearman rank correlation in safe rows

classification_rule.and_bootstrap_interval_excludes_zero: upgrade mule-deer timer evidence from T0 to T3_CANDIDATE and hybrid evidence to H1_CANDIDATE, because a physiological state measured before migration predicts readiness timing while D2 signed feedback is independently present
classification_rule.otherwise: retain T0/D2 or mark T3_UNRESOLVED; do not force upgrade
classification_rule.H2: never upgraded by this analysis; H2 requires readiness-gated phase-to-actuator feedback in a separate registered test

forbidden: use rows starting on/before March 31 as temporally ordered readiness evidence without exact capture dates
interpret a readiness main effect as H2 gating
retune frozen GEB V2 or preregistered outcomes
